notes.title: First Expansion "Undercover Expansion" Released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UhWI7VRtoOI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Jack and Detectives v0.2.1 Update Released![/h1]

[h2]Addition of the First Expansion: "Undercover Expansion"[/h2]

- New roles "Undercover Officer," "Undercover Jack," and "Undercover Jack Maniac" have been added.
- Each new role comes with the new action "Reveal," allowing players to declare themselves as an Undercover Officer to others.
- By purchasing the "Undercover Expansion" in the shop, players can use these new roles in Room Matches and Solo Mode.（They can also be played in Ranked Matches without purchasing the expansion。）

[h2]Ranked Matches[/h2]
- Ranked Matches now feature a weekly role balance adjustment.
- Players can experience slightly different rules each week.
- A new "Undercover Ticket" has been added, granting players priority access to the Undercover Officer role in Ranked Matches.


[h2]Room Matches[/h2]

- The role balance settings for each room are now displayed on the Room Match List screen.

[h2]Records & Rankings[/h2]

- With this update, records and rankings have been reset.
- In the next update, we plan to introduce a seasonal ranking system.

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]

- A cancel button has been added to the replay dialog before playback.
- Fixed a display issue in the news section.
- Adjusted some CPU behaviors for improved gameplay.
- On mobile devices, the game will no longer enter sleep mode during matches.

notes.title: On the anonymization of ranked matches
notes.content:
We will announce the specifications and policies of ranked matches as needed. Please follow the official X account and join Discord.

[Updated 2024/09/22]
From version 0.1.7, player names will be displayed in ranked matches.

[Updated 2024/09/21]
We have received multiple opinions regarding the anonymization of ranked matches.

The purpose of this update was to eliminate inconveniences such as meta-reasoning caused by seeing other players' names, while ensuring everyone can compete fairly under the same conditions. However, we understand that not displaying player names can reduce the inherent fun.

We will reconsider the specifications of ranked matches and make changes again soon.

notes.title: Anonymous Features Added!
notes.content:
Three anonymous features have been added. 

[Streamer Mode] 
All player names will be displayed as "Anonymous Detective." This can be set in the settings menu. 

[Anonymous Ranked Matches] 
Player names will be displayed anonymously during ranked matches regardless of the streamer mode settings. Player names will remain in the match history. 

[Anonymous Replays] 
Replays from the match history can now be played anonymously.

notes.title: The history button has been fixed!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience. 
We have fixed the issue where the history button could not be pressed. 

Please check the history of your previous battles!

notes.title: To those living in China
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing Jack and Detectives! 

We've received multiple reviews already, and among them, we've noticed several mentioning issues with starting the game. 
This game uses Google servers, so it cannot be accessed from within China. Therefore, it's possible that an error occurred due to the inability to properly connect during the game's startup, preventing the game from starting. 

If you live in China and purchased the game on Steam, please either request a refund or use a method to bypass China's internet restrictions to play. 

This patch will now display a similar message when starting the game.
